name: Mi Quang
summary: Mì Quảng is wide turmeric noodles with a small ladle of broth. Vietnam Tourism calls it the dish most often associated with Quảng Nam. VOV2 named it at the 24 Mar 2022 night program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn and did not name a stall.
origin: Quảng Nam. VOV2 placed one serving at Thôn Mỹ Sơn on 24 Mar 2022. Vietnam Tourism says the bowl is eaten across the province.
texture: Vietnam Tourism calls the noodles wide, flat, and chewy, and says the noodles and the broth are turmeric-yellow.
taste: Vietnam Tourism says there is less broth than in phở, and that the ladle is big on flavour. It also names chili, lime, and soy sauce if you want them.
howToEat: Toss the noodles with the herbs and the ladle of broth. Vietnam Tourism names pork, chicken, shrimp, or a mix, and says quail eggs or pork sausage may be in the bowl.
It finishes the bowl with crispy rice crackers and peanuts.
VOV2 names mì Quảng at a program that began at 16:00 on 24 Mar 2022. It does not describe the bowl. On 1 Dec 2025 Tuổi Trẻ quotes the deputy in charge saying the night calendar is not fixed.
The price is Check on arrival. An hour, outside that one program, is Check on arrival.
where: Thôn Mỹ Sơn, xã Duy Phú, is where VOV2 placed the 24 Mar 2022 program. It does not name a stall. The ticket information page forbids eating in the monument area.
The 24 Feb 2025 sanctuary essay names the brand Mỳ Quảng Mỹ Sơn and does not give a street. That brand is not a shop listed here.
Vietnam Tourism says variations are eaten at restaurants and street stalls across Quảng Nam. It does not name a stall at the gate.
seoTitle: Mi Quang — named at My Son on one 2022 night
seoDescription: Vietnam Tourism describes mì Quảng as the Quảng Nam bowl. VOV2 named it at Thôn Mỹ Sơn on 24 Mar 2022. No stall and no price were printed.
